textRun.content: Corporate Wine Tasting in Temecula | Kentina Group Events
A corporate wine tasting at Kentina is a hosted group experience at either

- two working wineries in Temecula, California. Your group receives a guided tasting flight, dedicated staff, a reserved space, and full coordination from inquiry to closing pour. This is not a casual drop-in visit. It is a planned corporate event structured around your team's needs.

Planning a wine tasting for a corporate group seems simple until you start handling the details. How many wines? Which venue? What unfolds when everyone arrives? How far ahead should you book? The sections below answer each of these questions based on how Kentina actually runs these events.
What a Corporate Wine Tasting at Kentina Includes

A corporate wine tasting is a reserved, hosted experience - not a walk-in visit. Your group gets dedicated service, a curated flight, and a host who controls the pace. Everything is arranged in advance so your team encounters no surprises.

Standard walk-in visitors blend into the tasting room's regular flow. Corporate groups operate in isolation. You receive your own reserved area, your own host, and a tasting structured specifically for group dynamics - pacing, commentary, and interaction built for teams rather than individuals exploring wine on their own.

The atmosphere shift is noticeable immediately. Your group is not competing for staff attention or navigating crowded tables with strangers. The experience centers on conversation, shared discovery, and the relaxed focus that actually helps teams connect.
A standard corporate tasting at Kentina includes:
A curated tasting flight of wines from the host property
A dedicated wine host who guides the group through each pour
Tasting notes and guidance on what to look for in each wine
Optional food pairings available to complement the flight (confirm at inquiry)
Full coordination support from first contact through day-of logistics
Two Distinct Venues for Different Group Needs

Kentina operates two distinct winery venues for corporate groups under one brand - a setup no other operator in Temecula wine country offers. Different group sizes and event goals call for different settings.
Masia de la Vinya: Spanish Varietals, Intimate Atmosphere

specializes in Spanish varietals within a boutique, close-knit environment. The tasting room rewards focused conversation and suits smaller corporate groups seeking a refined, attentive experience. Picture a leadership team offsite, a client appreciation event, or a tight-knit group that wants to slow down and genuinely talk.
Danza del Sol: Mediterranean Wines and Vineyard Views

showcases Mediterranean varietals and offers something Masia de la Vinya does not: expansive vineyard views and outdoor event options. The setting works for mid-to-large corporate groups who want the full wine-country backdrop as part of the experience.
- a designated wine region in Southern California recognized for its elevation, diurnal temperature swings, and consistent growing conditions that shape the wines your group will taste.
, Temecula's wine region hosts more than 40 licensed wineries, making it one of Southern California's most accessible wine destinations from San Diego, Los Angeles, and Riverside.

Not every corporate group wants the same experience. Kentina structures tastings to match your goals, whether that is focused education, a relaxed social hour, or something built around a specific theme.

The guided tasting flight forms the foundation of most corporate tastings. Your wine host walks the group through a sequence of wines - typically four to six pours - explaining each one's varietal, origin on the property, and what to notice in the glass. Groups taste together, ask questions together, and move at a shared pace. Duration typically runs 1.5 to 2 hours.

A private tasting reserves the space and host exclusively for your group. No other visitors share your setting. This format suits client entertainment, executive-level events, and any occasion where your team needs full privacy and an elevated atmosphere.

For groups wanting more structure or a specific narrative, a themed tasting builds the flight around a concept. That might mean exploring a single varietal across multiple vintages, contrasting Old World and New World styles, or walking through the Spanish and Mediterranean varietals that define each Kentina property. Themed sessions work particularly well for team building because they give the group a shared framework and naturally prompt conversation.
All corporate groups, first-time wine events
Corporate groups at Kentina range from small executive teams to large departmental gatherings. Event structure adapts across sizes:
Either venue works well. The intimate format lets the host engage directly with every guest, making the tasting feel personal rather than like a lecture.
Danza del Sol is best, where the space accommodates the group comfortably without crowding the experience. The host paces the flight to keep everyone together.

Danza del Sol's outdoor options and expanded capacity make it the practical choice. For very large groups, the event may run in sub-groups with staggered rotations - your coordinator will recommend the best structure at inquiry.
Kentina's corporate tastings typically start at 10 guests. Contact the team directly to confirm capacity for your preferred venue and date.
Your Event Timeline: From Arrival to Closing
Here is exactly what happens on the day of your tasting.
Your group arrives at the venue entrance. A Kentina team member meets you, confirms headcount, and directs everyone to your reserved space.
Your wine host introduces themselves, gives a brief venue overview, and sets expectations for the tasting - how many wines, how long it takes, and what to expect.
The host opens with the first wine, describing its varietal, character, and place in the property's portfolio. This opening sets a relaxed, conversational tone regardless of guests' wine knowledge.
The host moves the group through each wine, pausing between pours for questions and group observations. The pacing is intentional - there is time to talk, compare notes, and revisit a glass.
The best moments happen between pours. The host facilitates rather than dominates, creating space for the group to engage with each other as much as with the wine.
At the conclusion, the host opens the floor for final questions, shares additional property details, and points the group toward retail offerings or next scheduled activities.
Total time: 1.5 to 2 hours for a standard guided flight. Private and themed sessions may run longer depending on engagement.
How to Book Your Corporate Wine Tasting
Every corporate tasting at Kentina follows a straightforward process from first contact to day-of. Here is the path:
with your basic event details. The more specific you are, the faster the team can confirm availability and recommend the right venue and format.
Tasting format preference (guided flight, private, themed)
Any dietary restrictions or special requirements
Whether you want to combine the tasting with other Kentina experiences

Once the team receives your inquiry, they confirm which venue fits your group and recommend a tasting format based on your goals. This is also when food pairings and any customization requests get discussed.
Your coordinator confirms the date, venue, and format in writing. From here, Kentina handles the logistics - staffing, space setup, and flight curation.

Your group shows up. The team handles everything else. For groups traveling from San Diego, Los Angeles, or Riverside, factor in drive time - Temecula sits roughly 60 miles north of San Diego and 85 miles southeast of downtown Los Angeles. Arrange designated drivers or group transportation in advance.
If you want to expand beyond the tasting, Kentina's corporate retreat options let you build a full-day or multi-day itinerary around the wine experience.
Why Kentina Stands Out for Corporate Wine Tastings

The difference between a portable sommelier service and a Kentina group tasting is the setting itself. A wine presentation in a conference room can work. A guided tasting at an actual working winery, with vineyard rows visible from your seat and wines poured from the property you are standing on, lands differently.
Here is what makes Kentina practical for corporate groups in Southern California:
Two winery venues under one brand.
No other operator in the region offers two distinct Temecula winery properties for corporate bookings. You choose the setting that fits your group's size and vibe.
Temecula sits within a 1.5-hour drive from most of Southern California's business centers - close enough for a day event, far enough to feel like a genuine destination.
Beyond the tasting, Kentina's portfolio includes
for equestrian programming. A wine tasting becomes the centerpiece of a full corporate retreat itinerary.
The team coordinating your event operates the venues. There is no middleman, no third-party booking platform, and no generic package that ignores your group's actual needs.

Corporate groups can extend their time across Kentina's full property portfolio - golf at Cross Creek, glamping at Native Falls, equestrian experiences at Galway Downs. Ask your coordinator about building a complete retreat around your wine tasting.
How many people can join a corporate wine tasting at Kentina?

Corporate tastings typically start at 10 guests. Maximum capacity depends on the venue and format selected - Danza del Sol accommodates larger groups, particularly with its outdoor options. Contact the team with your headcount for a confirmed capacity recommendation.
How long does a corporate wine tasting last?
A standard guided tasting flight runs 1.5 to 2 hours. Private and themed sessions may extend depending on group size and engagement. Your coordinator confirms the expected duration when you book.
What wines are included in a group tasting flight?

The flight is curated from the host property's portfolio - Spanish varietals at Masia de la Vinya, Mediterranean varietals at Danza del Sol. Flights typically include four to six wines, sequenced to show range and contrast. Themed sessions adjust the selection around a specific focus.
Can we choose between Masia de la Vinya and Danza del Sol?

Yes. Both venues host corporate groups. Your Kentina coordinator helps you choose based on group size, preferred atmosphere, and whether outdoor space is a priority. The comparison table earlier in this guide is a good starting point.
Is food included in a corporate wine tasting?

Food pairing options are available and worth discussing at inquiry. Standard guided tastings focus on the wine flight. If your group wants a fuller food-and-wine experience, your coordinator advises on what pairings are available for your chosen venue and date.
How far in advance should we book?

For corporate groups, booking four to six weeks ahead is a reasonable baseline. Peak dates - particularly spring and fall weekends - fill faster. If you have a firm date in mind, reach out as early as possible to hold it.
Can we combine a wine tasting with other team-building activities?

Yes. Kentina's multi-property portfolio makes it straightforward to build a full day or retreat around the tasting. Golf, outdoor camping, and equestrian experiences are all available across Kentina's Temecula properties. Your coordinator structures a multi-activity itinerary.
Is a corporate wine tasting suitable for guests who don't drink wine?

The guided tasting format is educational and accessible, not purely consumption-focused. Guests who prefer not to drink can participate in the guided commentary and group experience. If non-drinking guests represent a significant portion of your group, mention this at inquiry so the team can adjust accordingly.
How do we start the booking process?
with your group size, preferred dates, and any initial format preferences. The team responds to confirm availability and next steps.
Can the tasting be customized for our group's preferences?

Yes. Themed sessions are built around a curated concept selected in coordination with your team. You can request specific pairings, branded elements, or integration with other Kentina experiences. Bring your requests to the inquiry conversation - the earlier you share them, the more the team can accommodate.
